goldens.comment: The rendered GrafanaRuleListItem is missing the required key prop for React list items. This can cause rendering issues when the list order changes.
goldens.reasoning: C1 points out the same missing key prop on GrafanaRuleListItem.

goldens.comment: RuleActionsButtons is invoked with only promRule, but SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer inside RuleActionsButtons still depends on a Grafana Ruler rule being present, so for Grafana rules coming from list views the 'Silence notifications' menu entry (now driven by Grafana Prom abilities) will toggle showSilenceDrawer without ever rendering the drawer. This means clicking 'Silence notifications' for these rules has no visible effect, even when abilities indicate silencing is allowed.
goldens.reasoning: G2 is about SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer needing a ruler rule, so 'Silence notifications' does nothing when only promRule is passed. C3 describes a similar promRule-only problem, but it is about the delete and pause items being gated, not the silence drawer. No candidate covers the silence issue.

candidates: Missing key prop on GrafanaRuleListItem in FilterView.tsx line 157 inside rules.map() function
Type signature mismatch: handleDelete expects RulerRuleDTO but call sites pass EditableRuleIdentifier

Delete and pause menu items are gated by rulerRule presence even though abilities are computed with OR logic from both ruler and Grafana sources, causing regression in promRule-only scenarios where delete/pause won't appear
